page_title: PAR 2-0 BOL | Parma v Bologna 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Santiago Castro (Bologna) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
90+3' Dennis Man (Parma) dribbles into the box, but Federico Ravaglia is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
85' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
84' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Moro is given a rest as he is replaced by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
84' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) replaces Sam Beukema.
80' Here comes a substitution. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Ange-Yoan Bonny.
80' Christian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Nahuel Estevez will be replaced by Drissa Camara (Parma).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Lovik (Parma) comes onto the pitch for Pontus Almqvist.
79' 2 - 0 Goal Simon Sohm (Parma)! Simon Sohm (Parma) was put through by Dennis Man and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
78' Nikola Moro (Bologna) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call.
74' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Tommaso Pobega is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
74' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
72' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) superbly rides the challenge and bends a shot in from distance that flies just over the bar.
68' Davide Calabria (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Rosario Abisso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi will be replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
66' Here is a change. Juan Miranda is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matteo Cancellieri as he is replaced by Dennis Man (Parma).
64' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
64' Juan Miranda (Bologna) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
63' Rosario Abisso blows the whistle, Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
60' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
57' Nikola Moro (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Parma get a free kick.
55' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
52' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Matteo Cancellieri (Parma).

51' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
47' Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is adjudged offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Remo Freuler (Bologna) plays a through ball but overhits it.
43' Nikola Moro (Bologna) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
43' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
41' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
41' Nikola Moro (Bologna) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
40' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) was too forceful with his tackle and Rosario Abisso interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to Bologna.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Federico Ravaglia into the bottom left corner.
37' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is going to take the penalty!
36' Referee Rosario Abisso is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Parma!
36' Celebrations by Parma are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
35' The players claim that Sam Beukema (Bologna) handled the ball and it seems they are right. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Parma.
34' The total number of attempts is 1:7. 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
34' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Dan Ndoye (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
32' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
32' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Now Bologna have a corner.
30' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
28' Wasted opportunity! Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
25' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) watches the cross in from Remo Freuler, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post.
22' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Zion Suzuki comfortably gathers the ball.
18' Santiago Castro (Bologna) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
17' Santiago Castro (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
15' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
11' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
10' Davide Calabria (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Davide Calabria (Bologna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
7' Remo Freuler (Bologna) brings an opponent down and Rosario Abisso interrupts the game.
5' Christian Chivu is forced to make a change. Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nahuel Estevez.
5' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

4' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Zion Suzuki.
2' A pass from Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is intercepted by Federico Ravaglia and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso will referee today's match.
